# openshift (cloudspider-openshift) v1.0.0

One EC2 host for OpenShift Local (CRC) with nested virtualization, reached only through SSM; it stops itself after maxHours and every night at 22:00 Prague time.

## Inputs

Set with `pulumi config set <key> <value>` or the STACKS card. Validated before any resource is created (upgrades/schema); the card runs the same check before it makes the stack.

| key | allowed | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| name | must be a short lowercase name (a-z, 0-9, -; 2-28 chars, starts with a letter) | cloudspider-openshift | instance name |
| instanceType | m7i-flex.2xlarge \| m7i.2xlarge \| c5.metal | m7i-flex.2xlarge | OpenShift Local host |
| maxHours | 1..12 | 4 | auto-stop after this many hours |
| nightlyStop | must be an EventBridge cron(...) expression | cron(0 22 * * ? *) | nightly stop schedule |

## Outputs

- `instanceId`
- `type`
- `publicIp`
- `autoStopHours`
- `nightly`
- `connect`
- `consoleTunnel`
- `CRC_URL`
- `SSM_URL`

## Guarantees

- Providers pinned: `@pulumi/aws` 7.50.0, `@pulumi/pulumi` 3.268.0 (package-lock.json).
- No data resources to protect.
- Policy pack: `pulumi preview --policy-pack ../policy-pack`.
- Tested under Pulumi mocks: upgrades/iac-matrix.json.
